description: Asphalt street with white painted parking lines, a row of mature green trees lining the street, a multi-story yellow building with white window frames, a brown "PAULINE'S PIZZA" sign with an orange pizza logo affixed to the building's corner, a smaller "OUTFRONT" sign below the pizza sign, a street sign on a pole reading "BROSNAN" at the building's corner, ground-floor windows with white vertical security bars, a large billboard on the upper part of the yellow building advertising "MARIN MARATHON" with runners and "www.marinmarathon.com", a large tree trunk in the right foreground, and a low brick retaining wall along the sidewalk.

A leafy green tree, a light-colored building with multiple windows above a red awning inscribed with "KWSF", a tall multi-story brick building with green bay windows and visible metal fire escapes, a distinctive modern Chase bank building with light-colored arched facade elements and blue "CHASE" signs, a city street sloping downhill with pedestrian crosswalks and traffic signal poles, and a distant cityscape featuring several high-rise buildings including one with a pointed spire.

Tree foliage, red-brown wooden fence, light green house with white trim, green garage door, two arched windows with blue frames, long green staircase, blue front door, dark blue roof with white decorative trim, bush with reddish foliage, concrete driveway, asphalt street with cracks.
